title: Everything You Need to Know About Selling Design Assets with Crypto Payments
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: In Zimbabwe, where PayPal and Stripe are heavily restricted, digital creators face a major infrastructural hurdle: how to sell ebooks, courses, and design assets with crypto payments without relying on foreign services. This problem isn't unique to Zimbabwe, as many countries face similar platform restrictions. In this post, we'll explore a solution for selling digital products using a sovereign digital commerce stack, leveraging NOWPayments for crypto pricing and automated delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround or a hack, but rather base-layer infrastructure that gives digital creators full ownership and control over their online stores, payment processing, and product delivery. This architecture is built on free and open-source tools, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, to create a decentralized and scalable solution for selling digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture relies on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery and NOWPayments for instant crypto payment verification. The solution also utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This combination of tools allows for seamless and secure transactions, without relying on foreign payment gateways.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives or delivered via hosted video links, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround, but rather base-layer infrastructure for selling digital products.

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, simply follow these steps: deploy a GitHub Pages site, set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for product delivery, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment verification, and configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. By following these steps, digital creators can create a fully functional online store, without relying on foreign payment gateways or services.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5-10%, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds. You receive 99.5% of the sale price directly into your self-custody wallet. No platform involved at any step.
Digital creators can maintain full ownership and control over their online stores and payment processing.
